inputs.text: A single Indian torana gateway of dark basalt and blackened iron, as at an ancient Buddhist stupa: two tall thick square stone posts covered in carved lotus-vine panels, with three stacked horizontal curved stone crossbeams above them, each beam ending in outward spiral scrolls. Between the square posts the open doorway is a plain tall rectangle glowing deep ember-orange. Plain iron chains with simple iron rings hang at the sides. Deep maroon and charcoal with ember red-orange accents, muted. Hades-inspired painterly game prop illustration, three-quarter top-down view, bold clean shapes, rich carved detail, a soft baked cast shadow, the whole object in frame and centered, alone on a flat, even, pale-grey background.
